text_blocks.snippet: Endometrioid cancer is the most common type of endometrial cancer, a malignancy that develops in the lining of the uterus (endometrium). It is a type of adenocarcinoma, meaning it originates in gland cells and can appear similar to the normal uterine lining. Most endometrial cancers are endometrioid carcinomas, while others are non-endometrioid types like serous or clear cell carcinomas.
